= Block state machine: waits and wakes

// Generated by tools/gen_engine_docs.py -- do not edit by hand.

An ordinary block's process (`BlockProcess`) waits at one of the sites below; an interrupt
(`Scheduler.interrupt`, delivered as a `Wake`) can end the wait early. `wait_sites.WAKE_POLICY`
says what may end each wait. Which of these combinations the models actually reach is on
xref:state-coverage.adoc[Block state coverage]. Regenerate with
`python tools/gen_engine_docs.py --write`.

== Wait sites

[cols="2,5,1,4,3",options="header"]
|===
| Site | Where | Timer | Reasons that end it | Condition
| `kickoff` | `run`: the kickoff barrier at t=0, before the first stress computation (port-only hop inside source's `Run` TELL start). | yes | `Dependence_All_Up`, `Dependence_Idle`, `Dependence_SB_turnOn`, `Dependence_Standby`, `Induced_Failure`, `OBPM` | a dependency dispatch has already applied its transition; an induced failure is taken at the first wait
| `idle` | `_idle_wait`: the Idle / ZeroWait wait at the top of `Run` (`ZeroWait:=TRUE; WAIT FOR BlockTrigger[seqNum] TO Fire`, Raptor 7). | no | `Dependence_All_Up`, `Dependence_Idle`, `Dependence_SB_turnOn`, `Dependence_Standby`, `Induced_Failure`, `OBPM`, `Phase_Change`, `Pool_Available`, `Start_Deferred_PM`, `Switch_Failed_Path`, `Switched_Off`, `Switched_On`, `Triggered_PM_Due` | Pool_Available only while a deferred PM request is outstanding
| `zero_stress` | `_run_turn`: the ZeroWait wait for a block whose combined stress is zero. | no | any (the wake is not read) | any wake re-checks the stress and redraws; the reason only feeds the startup-failure draw
| `park_a_hop` | `_cold_path_redraw`: the `WAIT DURATION 0.0` after PARK A's release | yes | none | 
| `fail_wait` | `_fail_wait`: the ordinary fail-wait (`FailWait:=TRUE; WAIT DURATION TimeToMaint`, Raptor 7). | yes | `Dependence_All_Up`, `Dependence_Idle`, `Dependence_SB_turnOn`, `Dependence_Standby`, `Induced_Failure`, `OBPM`, `Phase_Change`, `Pool_Available`, `Start_Deferred_PM`, `Switch_Failed_Path`, `Switched_Off`, `Switched_On`, `Triggered_PM_Due` | Pool_Available only when a deferred PM grant has landed; any reason is taken as that grant then
| `beyond_horizon` | `_fail_wait`: the same wait when the life overshoots the run, so it waits to the end of the run. | yes | `Dependence_All_Up`, `Dependence_Idle`, `Dependence_SB_turnOn`, `Dependence_Standby`, `Induced_Failure`, `OBPM`, `Phase_Change`, `Pool_Available`, `Start_Deferred_PM`, `Switch_Failed_Path`, `Switched_Off`, `Switched_On`, `Triggered_PM_Due` | as the fail-wait; the timer ends the run
| `pm_misdefer_run` | `_obtain_pm_prereqs`: the `ELSE Run` TELL after a pmMisDefer PM is deferred by mission. | yes | any (the wake is not read) | the wake is not read
| `pm_prereqs_tell` | `_obtain_pm_prereqs`: the `ObtainPMprereqs` TELL boundary | yes | `Dependence_All_Up`, `Dependence_Idle`, `Dependence_SB_turnOn`, `Dependence_Standby`, `Induced_Failure`, `OBPM`, `Phase_Change`, `Start_Deferred_PM`, `Switch_Failed_Path`, `Switched_Off`, `Switched_On`, `Triggered_PM_Due` | 
| `pm_hold_pool_spare` | `_obtain_pm_pool_spare`: PMhold waiting for a spare-pool spare (`WAIT FOR PooledSpares TO Give`). | no | `Pool_Available` | 
| `pm_hold_custom_spare` | `_obtain_pm_custom_spare`: PMhold waiting for a Custom spare | no | `Pool_Available` | 
| `pm_hold_resource` | `_request_pm_resource`: PMhold waiting for the PM's resources | no | `Pool_Available` | 
| `pm_handback` | `_obtain_pm_resource`: the hand-back hop to `Run` after the PM's resources are in hand. | yes | `Dependence_All_Up`, `Dependence_Idle`, `Dependence_SB_turnOn`, `Dependence_Standby`, `Induced_Failure`, `OBPM`, `Phase_Change`, `Pool_Available`, `Switch_Failed_Path`, `Switched_Off`, `Switched_On`, `Triggered_PM_Due` | Pool_Available only with token "pm" (an async PM-prerequisite grant)
| `pm_misdefer_hop` | `_obtain_pm_resource`: a pmMisDefer block's extra `WAIT DURATION 0.0` on the non-mission branch. | yes | any (the wake is not read) | the wake is not read
| `pm_scheduled_hop` | `_obtain_pm_prereqs`: a scheduled PM's `WAIT DURATION 0.0` before `DetermineNewState("PM is due")` for a pmMisDefer block. | yes | any (the wake is not read) | the wake is not read
| `pm_sync_wait` | `_obtain_pm_prereqs`: the `WAIT FOR pmSyncTrigger TO Fire` after it while a phase change is in progress; the phase change's end releases it. | no | any (the wake is not read) | the wake is not read
| `pm_sync_wait_handback` | `_obtain_pm_resource`: the same `WAIT FOR pmSyncTrigger` after the hand-back hop. | no | any (the wake is not read) | the wake is not read
| `pm_tail_hop` | `_obtain_pm_prereqs`: a PM with no resource to wait for pays the pmMisDefer tail's `WAIT DURATION 0.0` itself then the sync wait below. | yes | any (the wake is not read) | the wake is not read
| `pm_sync_wait_tail` |  | no | any (the wake is not read) | the wake is not read
| `defer_trigger_wait` | `_defer_maintenance`: a `maintDefer` block held in RepHold, waiting for the defer trigger to fire (`WAIT FOR trig TO Fire`). | no | `Trigger_Fired` | only the trigger's fire ends it (no ON INTERRUPT clause in source; FailWait and ZeroWait are clear)
| `perform_pm_tell` | `_perform_pm`: the `TELL PerformPM` boundary. | yes | `Dependence_All_Up`, `Dependence_Idle`, `Dependence_SB_turnOn`, `Dependence_Standby`, `Phase_Change`, `Switch_Failed_Path`, `Switched_Off`, `Switched_On`, `Triggered_PM_Due` | 
| `repair_custom_spare` | `_wait_for_custom_spare`: `Repair` waiting for a Custom spare | no | `Pool_Available` | 
| `repair_pool_spare` | `_wait_for_pool_spare`: `Repair` waiting for a spare-pool spare | no | `Pool_Available` | a "pm" token is a PM grant: reconciled, then the wait resumes
| `repair_resource_hop` | `_obtain_repair_resource`: the hop that lets a same-instant release land before the resource check. | yes | any (the wake is not read) | the wake is not read
| `repair_resource` | `_obtain_repair_resource`: `Repair` waiting in RepHold for its resources. | no | `Pool_Available` | 
| `repair` | `_repair_wait`: the repair itself (`WAIT DURATION TimeToRepair`, Raptor 7). | yes | `Pool_Available` | a stale PM grant: reconciled, then the repair resumes
|===

== Interrupt reasons

Each reason with the sites whose policy names it. Sites that do not read their wake
(policy "any") accept every reason and are not listed. A reason with no wait site is
delivered to another process (a cold-standby switch, a PM trigger, a dependent block) or
only recorded on the block.

[cols="2,3,5",options="header"]
|===
| Reason | Group | Accepted at
| `Dependence_Idle` | Dependency dispatch (`BackFlowDependencies`) | `kickoff`, `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`, `pm_handback`, `perform_pm_tell`
| `Dependence_All_Up` | Dependency dispatch (`BackFlowDependencies`) | `kickoff`, `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`, `pm_handback`, `perform_pm_tell`
| `Dependence_SB_turnOn` | Dependency dispatch (`BackFlowDependencies`) | `kickoff`, `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`, `pm_handback`, `perform_pm_tell`
| `Dependence_Standby` | Dependency dispatch (`BackFlowDependencies`) | `kickoff`, `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`, `pm_handback`, `perform_pm_tell`
| `Induced_Failure` | Dependency dispatch (`BackFlowDependencies`) | `kickoff`, `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`, `pm_handback`
| `OBPM` | Dependency dispatch (`BackFlowDependencies`) | `kickoff`, `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`, `pm_handback`
| `Switched_On` | Cold standby switching (`RunColdLogic`, `PerformSwitch`) | `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`, `pm_handback`, `perform_pm_tell`
| `Switched_Off` | Cold standby switching (`RunColdLogic`, `PerformSwitch`) | `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`, `pm_handback`, `perform_pm_tell`
| `Switch_Failed_Path` | Cold standby switching (`RunColdLogic`, `PerformSwitch`) | `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`, `pm_handback`, `perform_pm_tell`
| `PerformSwitch` | Cold standby switching (`RunColdLogic`, `PerformSwitch`) | _no wait site_
| `PerformSwitch_reconfigure` | Cold standby switching (`RunColdLogic`, `PerformSwitch`) | _no wait site_
| `Phase_Change` | Phasing (`ChangePhases`) | `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`, `pm_handback`, `perform_pm_tell`
| `Scheduled_PM` | Preventive maintenance | _no wait site_
| `Triggered_PM_Due` | Preventive maintenance | `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`, `pm_handback`, `perform_pm_tell`
| `Start_Deferred_PM` | Preventive maintenance | `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_prereqs_tell`
| `Obtained_PM_Prereqs` | Preventive maintenance | _no wait site_
| `Trigger_Fired` | Preventive maintenance | `defer_trigger_wait`
| `Pool_Available` | Resource/spare pools (`Give`) | `idle`, `fail_wait`, `beyond_horizon`, `pm_hold_pool_spare`, `pm_hold_custom_spare`, `pm_hold_resource`, `pm_handback`, `repair_custom_spare`, `repair_pool_spare`, `repair_resource`, `repair`
|===
